fn summa(p_numeri: Vec<i64>) -> i64 {
    let mut l_total: i64 = 0;
    for i0 in &(p_numeri) {
        let l_n = i0.clone();
        l_total = faber::exact::store::<i64>(faber::exact::add(l_total as i128, l_n as i128), "assignment to `total`");
    }
    l_total
}

fn main() {
    let l_valores: Vec<i64> = vec![1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
    println!("{}", summa(l_valores.clone()));
}
